name: foundry
description: Official foundry v1.8.1 executables, SHA-256 pinned for Linux x86_64/aarch64. Opportunistic runtime, no reserved build capacity.
prepare:
import hashlib,io,json,pathlib,platform,subprocess,tarfile,urllib.request
root=pathlib.Path('/workspace'); root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
assets={'x86_64': {'url': 'https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/v1.8.1/foundry_v1.8.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz', 'sha256': '37b45855232e57624d90113b049ca54f0c92055bb5c1997fcbdc3076c7b89c10'}, 'aarch64': {'url': 'https://github.com/foundry-rs/foundry/releases/download/v1.8.1/foundry_v1.8.1_linux_arm64.tar.gz', 'sha256': '27a32bd282d73018ab4d043de15ab0320b561c71b4bf3a549b130a0806e79f5c'}}
asset=assets[platform.machine()]
data=urllib.request.urlopen(asset['url'],timeout=120).read()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==asset['sha256'], 'Archive digest mismatch'
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(data),mode='r:gz') as archive:
    for name in ['forge', 'cast', 'anvil', 'chisel']:
        matches=[m for m in archive.getmembers() if pathlib.PurePosixPath(m.name).name==name and m.isfile()]
        assert len(matches)==1, 'Expected one executable: '+name
        binary=root/name; binary.write_bytes(archive.extractfile(matches[0]).read()); binary.chmod(0o700)
        subprocess.run([str(binary),'--version'],check=True)
